replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. Math is like a puzzle to me. I enjoy the challenge and the sense of accomplishment when I solve a problem. However, complex equations can sometimes be frustrating, but that motivates me to learn more.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI math tutor app. It helped me understand algebra and calculus better. The step-by-step explanations were clear, and I liked that I could practice at my own pace. It made learning less intimidating.
